FII.verified_context: Foreign portfolio investors returned as net buyers during July.
FII.note: Reported monthly totals vary by data cutoff and whether NSE/BSE/MSEI cash data or NSDL FPI data is used.

DII.verified_context: Domestic institutions remained net buyers and provided market support.
DII.note: DII activity is aggregate market data; sector-level allocation is not directly reported by NSE.

market_wide_FII_DII.NSE_BSE_daily_data: NSE provides daily FII/FPI and DII buy, sell and net values for the capital market.
market_wide_FII_DII.sector_data_method: Sector-specific FII direction uses publicly reported NSDL-derived sector allocation data; DII sector direction is qualitative unless a reliable sector-specific disclosure exists.

important_methodology_note: Do not interpret sector-level DII labels as exact rupee flows.
NSE daily FII/DII reports are market-wide, not sector-specific.
Sector-specific FII data is reported periodically from NSDL-derived holdings.
Stock-level institutional activity is inferred from its sector exposure.
This avoids fabricating unavailable stock-level FII/DII transaction values.

verified_sector_flow_highlights.source_context: NSDL-derived sectoral data reported during July showed consumer services, metals, healthcare, realty and financials favored, while auto, capital goods and telecom saw selling.
